about.title: About Our Factory
about.description: JS Silage & Wanda Factory has been at the heart of Pakistan's agricultural community for over a decade. Our state-of-the-art facility produces premium silage in Open, Baled, and Bags to meet the diverse needs of livestock farmers nationwide.

product_items.name: Open Silage
product_items.description: Loose, high-moisture silage loaded directly from our silos. Ideal for large-scale dairy farms.

product_items.name: Baled Silage
product_items.description: Wrapped, fermented bales with excellent preservation. Easy to handle, store, and transport.

product_items.name: Bagged Silage
product_items.description: Convenient, sealed bags with consistent quality. Perfect for small to medium farms.
